name: Farm Animals
description: Farm animals word search puzzles gather the calm English of barns, pastures and farmyards — hen, lamb, calf, donkey, duck, trough and hayloft — written for adults and seniors who want a gentle rural theme. Every grid is free to play online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles with words in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. Word lists stay everyday and brand-free: no cartoon mascots, no feed-store trademarks, just the animals and chores many of us grew up around. This hub sits under our Animals collection and pairs well with Horses, Birds and Farming when you want a wider countryside session. New to the site? Read how to play, or start with a large-print farm puzzle if smaller type tires the eyes.
